newNodes.name: Logarithms
newNodes.emerged: 1614 CE (Napier, Mirifici logarithmorum canonis descriptio); 1617-1624 CE (Briggs' base-10 tables); ~1,620 CE (Gunter's scale)
newNodes.prereqRationale: hindu_arabic: Briggs' tables are decimal. trigonometry: Napier built logarithms to shorten sine products in astronomy and navigation. Both are dated centuries before 1614.
newNodes.desc: Tables that turn multiplication into addition. Navigators, astronomers and surveyors compute in minutes what took hours, and Gunter's scale puts the method in a ship's master's hands.
newNodes.effectRationale: Quick dead-reckoning and position computation at sea mean shorter, safer voyages: cheaper bulk haulage.
newNodes.distinctFrom: calculus (A7) is the theory of rates; logarithms are a computational shortcut 60 years earlier, used by practitioners rather than theorists.
newNodes.rationale: hindu_arabic: Briggs' tables are decimal. trigonometry: Napier built logarithms to shorten sine products in astronomy and navigation. Both are dated centuries before 1614.

newNodes.name: Electrostatics and the lightning rod
newNodes.emerged: 1745 CE (Leyden jar, von Kleist and Musschenbroek); 1752 CE (Franklin's lightning rod)
newNodes.prereqRationale: barometer_vacuum (1643 CE): Hauksbee's glass-globe friction machine came out of air-pump work, and the Leyden jar is glasswork from the same laboratories.
newNodes.desc: Friction machines, the Leyden jar and Franklin's experiments show that lightning is electricity. Grounded rods protect roofs, steeples and powder magazines.
newNodes.effectRationale: Lightning rods stop strike fires: buildings last longer.
newNodes.distinctFrom: electromagnetism (A8) is current electricity and induction; electrostatics is the earlier science of charge, and its only direct product is the lightning rod.
newNodes.rationale: barometer_vacuum (1643 CE): Hauksbee's glass-globe friction machine came out of air-pump work, and the Leyden jar is glasswork from the same laboratories.

newNodes.name: Synoptic meteorology
newNodes.emerged: 1854-1861 CE (Le Verrier's telegraphed weather network after the Balaklava storm, 1854; FitzRoy's storm warnings, 1861)
newNodes.prereqRationale: barometer_vacuum: pressure readings are the observation. telegraph (1837 CE): simultaneous reports from many stations are what make a weather map possible. Both predate 1854.
newNodes.desc: Simultaneous barometer readings, telegraphed to one office, become a weather map. Storm warnings reach ports, and frost warnings reach growers.
newNodes.effectRationale: Frost and storm warnings save crops at critical moments and keep ships in port through gales.
newNodes.distinctFrom: weather_prediction (A9, engineering) is computer-based numerical forecasting from 1950; this is the earlier telegraph-and-map forecast, and it bridges barometer_vacuum to it.
newNodes.rationale: barometer_vacuum: pressure readings are the observation. telegraph (1837 CE): simultaneous reports from many stations are what make a weather map possible. Both predate 1854.

newNodes.name: Metric system
newNodes.emerged: 1795-1799 CE (France: metre and kilogram defined, platinum standards 1799); 1875 CE (Metre Convention)
newNodes.prereqRationale: standard_weights: the older state measure it replaces. trigonometry: the metre came from the Delambre-Mechain meridian triangulation. chemistry_quantitative (1789 CE): the kilogram was defined by a mass of water, and Lavoisier sat on the commission. All are dated before 1795.
newNodes.desc: Decimal units defined by nature and kept by international standards. Goods, land and loads are measured the same way in every market.
newNodes.effectRationale: Common decimal units remove conversion and disputes between markets, so trade closes price gaps faster.
newNodes.distinctFrom: standard_weights (A3) are local state standards; the metric system is a decimal, nature-based, international system tied to geodesy and chemistry.
newNodes.rationale: standard_weights: the older state measure it replaces. trigonometry: the metre came from the Delambre-Mechain meridian triangulation. chemistry_quantitative (1789 CE): the kilogram was defined by a mass of water, and Lavoisier sat on the commission. All are dated before 1795.

findings: Dependency and Age changes proposed: 4. geometry_practical drops its script clause, which duplicates the one surveying already carries (no closure change). abacus replaces chinese_script with counting_rods (the suanpan descends from rod arithmetic). electromagnetism adds the new electrostatics node (Volta's pile came from the science of charge). radioactivity moves A9 to A8 by its own dates (1896-1898); its prerequisites are A8 and its dependents A9, so no edge or sweep is affected.

Gap fill: 4 new nodes. A7: logarithms and electrostatics (the lightning rod is the lane's only building-durability effect). A8: synoptic_meteorology (it bridges barometer_vacuum to the A9 weather_prediction) and metric_system (decimal, international measure; the A3 standard_weights had no modern successor).

Operand pressure: the science lane naturally wants research.researchPointsCoefficient, and the other groups already sum to 0.26 against a cap of 0.3. This group uses it on only four landmarks (hindu_arabic, calculus, chemistry_quantitative, quantum_mechanics; 0.12), so the combined sum (~0.38) still exceeds the cap. Other pure-science nodes are routed to the university operands (maxResearchCostReduction, maturityTauYears, maxMortalityReduction) or to research.civicsPointsCoefficient. The integrator should rescale RP deltas or raise the cap.

Many late science nodes are pure theory with no direct registry operand: quantum_mechanics, relativity, electromagnetic_field_theory, nuclear_fusion_research, space_probe and space_telescope. Their effects are institutional (university and specialist-class operands) and kept small (0.01-0.03). A registry row for research-cost or knowledge diffusion would fit them better than borrowing.

Cost outliers to check in the section-5 calibration: nuclear_fission (267,620, 5.7x the A9 median, a research pile whose power comes through reactor nodes), laser (4.0x), haber_bosch (4.0x, a landmark), calculus (3.4x the A7 median) and chemistry_quantitative (3.4x, a hub of 21 dependents).

A8/A9 boundary: radioactivity (1896) is the only science node moved. vacuum_tube (1906), genetics_mendel (1900/1915), relativity (1905/1915), plastics (1907) and radiation_detection (1908-1911) are kept in A9 because their practical effect comes after 1914.

Cross-group bridge (not applied): double_entry is a leaf whose stated next step is banking; central_banking and joint_stock (C3, economy-commerce) could take double_entry as a prerequisite or OR alternative. This is routed to the integrator.

Live unlocks in this group are building.university (geometry_axiomatic OR algebra, with medicine_hippocratic), building.observatory (astronomy_geometric OR astrolabe OR telescope), building.research_laboratory, building.chemical_works and building.refinery. inst.natural_philosophy, inst.scientific_society, inst.statistics_vital and project.probe_acceleration are not live, so those nodes are marked deferred and carry operand effects.
